name: IGRIS-C
dof_breakdown: body 31 excluding hands; each hand 6 active / 11 total DOF
summary: Korea's first full-stack humanoid — Robros builds the actuators, hands and control stack itself — shown at CES 2026 and already running on factory floors. Its distinguishing piece is the hand: a tendon-driven design at about 300 g per hand where cable routing couples the joints while still allowing independent finger control, avoiding bulky linkages.

sources.title: Robros showcases IGRIS-C at CES 2026 — AVING News
